Definition
[Little Hölder spaces (Definitions 35.20--35.21)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0313 1. ch35:35.20–35.21\group Maximal Regularity

The little Hölder space $h^{r+\rho }$ is the closure of smooth functions (or smooth symmetric $2$-tensors on $\mathcal M$) in the $C^{r,\rho }$ norm. For $s\le r$ and $0<\sigma <\rho <1$ the inclusion $h^{r+\rho }\hookrightarrow h^{s+\sigma }$ is continuous and dense.
